title: Design Hotel Room and Reservation System
description: Model rooms, room types, guests, reservations, and availability checks.

data.text: Design a hotel management system. Rooms have types (Standard, Deluxe, Suite). Guests make reservations with check-in/out dates. Prevent double-booking.
Room is an entity with type and amenities. Reservation links Room, Guest, and date range. Hotel holds all rooms and finds available ones by date overlap.

data.title: Room, Guest, and Reservation
Why DateOnly?
data.text: Use DateOnly for check-in/out dates. Time zones and times-of-day create bugs in hotel software. DateOnly makes the intent explicit: reservations are by date, not by moment.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: RoomType enum drives search and pricing
SearchAvailability filters by type then excludes booked rooms
Book validates availability before creating the reservation
data.takeaway: Hotel management is fundamentally a date-range overlap problem. Keep dates as DateOnly, and let Reservation own its overlap logic.
